ITEM 1 | Dense mound of finely cut, ruffled dark green leaves with lighter green stems and veins, slightly moist with a matte surface, spanning roughly 60% of the bowl's interior, piled about 4-5 cm high at center and sitting directly in a white square bowl about 20 cm across | 90
ITEM 2 | Thin pale green leaves with pale stems and a few darker green blades interspersed through the greens, matte and fresh-looking, scattered across the central mound | 10
ITEM 3 | Small pale yellow-green chunks, roughly 1-2 cm, with slightly glossy, firm surfaces, clustered on the lower right side of the greens | 15
ITEM 4 | Thin round radish slices, about 2-3 cm across, bright red skin with white interior edge, one visible on the left side of the greens and a few small red pieces near the top center | 8
